boundaries.title: Frontend <-> FastAPI
boundaries.security_and_resilience: CORSMiddleware allowlist; GET requests omit Content-Type to prevent preflight overhead; 4s stall warning + 30s analyzer timeout; TextRequest forbids extra fields.

boundaries.title: FastAPI <-> PyTorch Inference
boundaries.protocol_or_format: In-process Python calls -> PyTorch tensors on MODEL_DEVICE
boundaries.security_and_resilience: Lazy model initialization raising ModelNotReadyError -> 503 model_not_ready; ONNX Runtime is verified offline for logit parity only, not live serving.

boundaries.title: Offline Notebooks & Drive <-> Artifacts
boundaries.source_layer: Colab Notebooks (00-03) & Logical NLP Lab Workspace
boundaries.protocol_or_format: sync_drive.py CLI + JSON, Safetensors, NumPy & ONNX files
inputs: Kaggle Amazon Reviews & HF GoEmotions datasets
boundaries.security_and_resilience: Raw datasets are excluded from Git (data/README.md) and API samples return approved=false; public manifests sanitize away mounted Drive paths, Drive IDs, and personal paths.

boundaries.title: Docker & GitHub Actions CI
outputs: frontend npm run verify (lint, typecheck, 9 contract suites, build)

technologies.name: Python
technologies.status_note: Core runtime powering FastAPI, PyTorch inference, ONNX export checks, and manifest scripts.
technologies.role: Executes the backend API server, ML inference wrappers, pytest suite, and deterministic repository generators.
technologies.communication_boundary: Runs backend.app.main:app on Uvicorn and loads ml/ inference modules plus data/*.json artifacts.

technologies.name: FastAPI
technologies.status_note: Active HTTP API layer serving inference, readiness, datasets, Model Lab, and technology endpoints.
technologies.role: Exposes REST routes on :8000 with CORSMiddleware, RequestValidationError 422 handlers, and OpenAPI schema generation.
technologies.communication_boundary: Receives HTTP/JSON from the Next.js client, validates via Pydantic, and delegates to PyTorch wrappers or data/*.json.

technologies.name: Uvicorn
technologies.status_note: Active ASGI server used in Docker, local dev, and CI Playwright smoke runs.
technologies.role: Serves backend.app.main:app on :8000 across local, containerized, and CI verification environments.
technologies.communication_boundary: Terminates inbound HTTP connections on :8000 and dispatches ASGI events to FastAPI.

technologies.name: Pydantic
technologies.status_note: Active request/response contract enforcement driving docs/openapi.json.
technologies.role: Validates TextRequest (extra='forbid', 1..10,000 chars) and serializes typed response models across all API endpoints.
technologies.communication_boundary: Sits at the FastAPI ingress/egress boundary, turning invalid inputs into structured 422 ErrorResponse payloads.

technologies.name: PyTorch
technologies.status_note: Active live inference engine on MODEL_DEVICE (cpu default); trained on Tesla T4 (2.14.1+cu130).
technologies.role: Trains both models in Colab and executes live inference for Amazon Word2Vec BiLSTM and GoEmotions DistilBERT.
technologies.communication_boundary: Receives token IDs from Gensim/Transformers, runs neural forward passes, and returns probabilities to FastAPI.

technologies.name: Hugging Face Transformers
technologies.status_note: Active tokenizer and DistilBERT sequence classifier runtime for POST /predict/go-emotions.
technologies.role: Loads AutoTokenizer (max_length=128) and AutoModelForSequenceClassification (28 labels) from artifacts/models/distilbert_goemotions.
technologies.communication_boundary: Converts raw text into WordPiece tensors and executes the fine-tuned DistilBERT PyTorch model.

technologies.name: Safetensors
technologies.status_note: Verified model weight format (model.safetensors) served by GoEmotionsInference.
technologies.role: Stores fine-tuned DistilBERT weights without Python pickle deserialization risk.
technologies.communication_boundary: Streams verified weight tensors from artifacts/models/distilbert_goemotions/model.safetensors into PyTorch.

technologies.name: Gensim
technologies.status_note: Partial dependency discrepancy: required by ml/amazon_rating/inference.py (gensim.utils.simple_preprocess) and pinned in configs/requirement.txt, but omitted from backend/requirements.txt.
technologies.role: Trains 200-d Word2Vec Skip-gram embeddings offline and tokenizes Amazon reviews in live inference.
technologies.communication_boundary: Normalizes raw review text (deacc=True) into token sequences prior to vocab.json ID lookup in AmazonInference.

technologies.name: NumPy
technologies.status_note: Active array runtime for embedding_matrix.npy loading and ONNX parity comparison.
technologies.role: Loads pretrained Word2Vec embedding matrices (vocab_size x 200) and computes max-absolute-error checks.
technologies.communication_boundary: Bridges persisted .npy weights and tensor outputs between disk, PyTorch, and ONNX Runtime.

technologies.name: scikit-learn
technologies.status_note: Verified evaluation runtime generating committed test metrics and classification reports.
technologies.role: Computes stratified splits, macro/micro/weighted F1, Hamming loss, subset accuracy, and confusion matrices.
technologies.communication_boundary: Transforms model test predictions into reports/metrics/*.json consumed by /statistics and /models/lab.

technologies.name: ONNX & ONNX Runtime
technologies.status_note: Export & parity only (opset_version=17, CPUExecutionProvider): verified max_absolute_error 1.19e-07 (Amazon) and 3.34e-06 (GoEmotions) <= 1e-4; live FastAPI endpoints serve PyTorch directly.
technologies.role: Exports both PyTorch models to .onnx graphs and verifies CPU logit parity against PyTorch references.
technologies.communication_boundary: Consumes loaded PyTorch models in scripts/export_and_check_onnx.py and emits parity-checked .onnx artifacts.
